meta.title: Custom Report Builder: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Determine Custom Report Builder availability on a Growth-plan tenant and an Enterprise-plan tenant using the same Tenant Admin role.
Sign in to the specified lower-plan and Enterprise tenants because no tenant identifiers are provided and no catalog step can select a plan.
Build custom reports with user-selected fields and formulas because no catalog step reaches or operates the Custom Report Builder.
